text:
maria_cs: Quick planning thread — window workshop for the Cadet MicroCert cohort migrating to Dedicated. Need three evening sessions next week to cover APAC & EMEA handoffs and one 1:1 targeted for a renewal-risk customer (KestrelMed). Proposed: 2024-11-14, 11-16, 11-18 at 21:00 UTC. Who can lead and what will you cover? Also need a short post-session feedback flow.

jon_eng: I can take 11/14 and 11/16. Will demo model pinning, KV cache warmup, and quantization basics. Recommend seeding dev envs for attendees.

tess_enable: I'll take 11/18 and build a guided lab + two fail-cases. Agree on seeded envs to keep labs smooth.

raj_sre: I'll standby for infra questions first 30m each night. If heavy KV tests planned, tell me 24h ahead so I can pre-warm.

oliver_pm: Session plan (60m): 5m intro, 20m demo, 25m hands-on, 10m Q&A + feedback. I'll own the short CSAT form and capture notes. Happy to run the KestrelMed 1:1 follow-up.

maria_cs: Creating a quick poll (21:00 vs 00:00 UTC) to check APAC preference — please react only. I'll lock slots after poll closes. :calendar: 

reminder-bot: Poll created: https://redwood.tools/polls/1749994322 — options: 21:00 UTC, 00:00 UTC. Closes in 24h.

ajira: Ticket CS-1289 created to track KestrelMed renewal playbook + 1:1 actions (assignee: maria_cs).

jon_eng: Dropped provisional calendar entries here: https://calendar.redwood.com/c/microcert-cadet — don't finalize until poll done. Voted 21:00.

tess_enable: I'll attach the prompt sets and the fail-case checklist into CS-1289 before EOD.

raj_sre: If you post expected KV QPS and keyspace in CS-1289 I'll pre-warm accordingly.

maria_cs: Great — trainers locked: jon_eng (14,16), tess_enable (18), raj_sre standby, oliver_pm owns feedback. I'll send invites once poll closes and add the KestrelMed 1:1 slot. Thanks! :thumbsup:
